normalization: Chinese and Arabic numeral equivalents; colloquial 一千二 treated as 1200
matching: Minimum character edit distance against a contiguous output substring; exact checkpoint requires zero edits. Numeric values require an unambiguous complete value inside the matched span.
reference_review: Codex visual review of fixed source frames; no human audio ground-truth transcript
execution_notes: Independent groups did not read other groups or reference/score artifacts
Local free group used Whisper small for six samples; four mainly used FunASR, including one with extra Whisper cross-check
Cloud free group reused same-source Paraformer-v1 full transcripts and successfully re-recognized six short segments
Cloud fixed groups reused same-trial OCR artifacts
Network retries, OCR reuse, and preparation time prevent strict speed ranking
privacy: Anonymous aggregate/per-video counters only; source videos, full transcripts, API keys, local paths, signed URLs, and session histories are not included.
